caption: The drawing depicts a full-body figure of a man standing on a rectangular pedestal. The man is wearing a long, layered coat in shades of brown with a lustrous texture, wide light brown pants, and red shoes with upturned toes. Around his neck, he wears a beaded necklace with a large, circular medallion. The man has a mustache and goatee, and he is adorned with a large, decorated hat that features green and brown patterns radiating outward from the crown. In his right hand, he holds a cube-shaped object. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or scenery present. The drawing uses subtle shading to represent the folds in the clothing and the solidity of the figure and pedestal.
title: Male Tea Shop Figure
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
